claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: N-MPPP is an opioid receptor agonist with no listed targets; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, as opioid receptor agonists generally lack broad cytotoxic activity and no off-target killing mechanism is evident.
